question: In the freeway or expressway lane-ends sequence in Figure 2C-13, which symbol sign is shown nearest the beginning of the lane-reduction taper?
model_answer: Direct Answer: In the "A – Freeway or expressway - lane ends" sequence of Figure 2C-13, the symbol sign shown nearest the beginning of the lane-reduction taper is the Lane Ends (W4-2R) sign. It is placed at the advance placement distance from the taper per Table 2C-3, while the word-legend RIGHT LANE ENDS (W9-1R) sign and its W16-2P distance plaque are located farther upstream. Guidance (recommended): - "The Lane Ends (W4-2) sign should be installed at the advance placement distance in accordance with Table 2C-3." Options (permitted): - "Where a lane ends a distance beyond the intersection that is less than the advance placement distance indicated in Table 2C-3, the W4-2 sign may be located at the far side of the intersection (see Sheet 4 of Figure 2C-13)." Visual evidence: [Image 1] shows the freeway/expressway lane-ends sequence with the W4-2R symbol sign positioned closest to the taper, with the dimension arrow labeled "See Table 2C-3 to determine the advance placement distance" measured from the sign to the start of the taper. [Image 2] (full page view of the same figure sheet) confirms the W4-2R symbol sign is the upstream-nearest sign to the taper, with the optional W9-1R and W16-2P plaque farther downstream in the drawing (upstream in travel direction). [Image 4] shows the companion pavement-marking figure where the W4-2R sign is likewise placed at distance AP in advance of the taper. [Image 5] shows the left-lane counterparts (W4-2L) similarly placed nearest the taper, illustrating the same sequence pattern. Citations: - Figure 2C-13 (p.185) - Section 2C.47 Support §1 (p.183) - Section 2C.47 Support §2 (p.183) - Section 2C.47 Guidance §3 (p.186) - Section 2C.47 Option §7 (p.186) - Page 226 - Page 608 - Page 228
gold_answer: The W4-2R Lane Ends symbol sign.
